about: Limits content to a maximum inline size, centres it in its parent and pads each side with a gutter.

flush.about: A `sm` container in a 384px room. Without `flush` the gutter starts the card 20px from the room's edge. With `flush` the card starts at the edge.
flush.title: Gutter

payouts: Payouts reach your bank account two business days after a charge settles. Weekends and bank holidays add one day.
